Subject: Request: detailed network isolation narrative + diagrams

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking our call yesterday. As part of HelioBank's vendor due diligence we are collecting a short evidence packet that explains how Redwood's runtime enforces tenant isolation and controls egress at the network level. Specifically the security team asked for:

- A short threat narrative (3–4 scenarios) showing realistic attack paths and mitigations for cross-tenant data exfiltration;
- Network diagrams showing the control-plane / data-plane separation and egress choke points;
- Any evidence artifacts you can share (config snapshots, access control lists, telemetry provenance examples).

Can you send a consolidated thread we can upload to our RFP portal? Ideally we need this by EOD tomorrow (2028-07-03). Matt from ThirdPath is our retained assessor and will comment inline.

Appreciate it —
Alice Byrne

Subject: Re: Request: detailed network isolation narrative + diagrams

Alice / Matt —

Thanks — attaching a focused packet that addresses the ask. High-level summary up front:

1) Isolation model: our runtime uses a layered isolation model combining process-level sandboxing, per-tenant network policy enforcement at the sidecar, and strict control-plane separation. Each tenant receives a logical enclave that has a dedicated inference worker pool (shared GPU scheduling is avoided for high-sensitivity tiers).

2) Egress controls: egress is mediated through a tenant-specific egress proxy (sidecar) with allowlists controlled by the customer's account bundle. Control-plane services (model catalog, metrics) are in a separate VPC with one-way, authenticated RPCs into the data-plane; there is no control-plane-initiated remote shell access.

3) Threat scenarios included: privileged sidecar compromise, CVE in third-party runtime dependency, and supply-chain model replacement. For each scenario we list probable attacker steps, detection signals (telemetry), and mitigation controls (circuit breakers, automatic model rollbacks).

Attachments included: segmented_runtime_pathways.pdf (diagram + narrative), shadowmap_v1.vsdx (editable diagram), evidence-index.csv (artifact list and anchors). I also published the high-res diagram to a controlled Drive link for your assessor: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GFk9aZ-example-diagram

If you want, we can set up a 30-minute walkthrough with our infra lead (Marcus) tomorrow afternoon.

-Jasmine
